config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Your own Polygon EOA private key. Enables the trading tools (place_order, sell_order, cancel_order, get_open_orders, get_positions). Omit to run signal-only, which needs no key and no wallet.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Per-order USD cap for the trading tools (default 100). Enforced server-side against the market's own price, so a caller cannot understate an order to slip past it.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Rolling UTC-day USD cap shared by place_order and sell_order (default 500). Held in a persisted ledger, so it survives restarts.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to additionally register redeem_position. A second opt-in beyond the private key, because it submits a real on-chain transaction through Polymarket's relayer and is still in testing.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to let check_news fall back to Polymarket's own market search when nothing in the cached set matches. Off by default: the query is built from the caller's text and leaves the machine.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Where the spend ledger is stored (default ~/.actually-mcp-server/spend-guard.json).

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Only if you run your own Cloudflare Worker instead of the shared default.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Shared secret for your own Worker. Not a private credential: the default one ships inside every client by design.
